entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `GivenDotnetPackageAdd` `noRestore=false` fails to work with package source mapping #52439
  • Disable wasm satellite assembly tests to unblock the main codeflow #52429
  • `dotnet add --file apphost.cs reference Awesome.Project.csproj` is not supported yet #52423
  • [NETSDKE2E]With NET10 SDK+ net11 SDK installed on win-x64, there is no net10.0 tfm in “Template option” after running "dotnet new console -h" in CLI. #52419
  • [NETSDKE2E] With NET11 SDK installed, there is a Warning: Failed to read or parse localization file when first time create new project in CLI. #52418

Closed

  • [NETSDKE2E]With NET11 SDK installed, bad layout for "dotnet --info" when opening command with administrator #52278
  • Change how the helix tests work with the framework package in CI #42845
  • Publish NativeAot fails with LNK1181 with spaces in Source Link path #52426
  • Unhandled exception: System.FormatException: The specified version does not contain a valid major, minor, and patch version: 'linux'. #52425
  • ProcessFrameworkReferences should add NativeAOT targeting packs for download for all passed in RIDs, not just RuntimeIdentifier #50093

Created

  • [WIP] Update SdkInstallCommand to use InstallRootManager #52441
  • Fix GivenDotnetPackageAdd test failures with package source mapping for Central Package Management #52440

  • Revise .NET version sections in README.md #52172

    Area-NetSDK, Test Debt
